currentWholeGoal.title: DNA, Gen und Chromosom als Informationsträger verknüpfen
currentWholeGoal.titleEn: Relate DNA, genes and chromosomes as information carriers
currentWholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann in einem einfachen Modell DNA als Material der Erbinformation, ein Gen als Abschnitt dieses Materials und ein Chromosom als organisierte Trägerstruktur unterscheiden und miteinander verknüpfen.
currentWholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can use a simple model to distinguish and relate DNA as the material of genetic information, a gene as a section of that material and a chromosome as an organised carrier structure.

resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: DNA, Gen und Chromosom als Informationsträger verknüpfen.
resourceLinks.altText: Ein schematisches Chromosom wird zur DNA-Doppelhelix entfaltet; ein hervorgehobener DNA-Abschnitt ist als Gen markiert. Größen und Abschnittslänge sind vereinfacht.

cropMethod: Lossless rectangular native-pixel excerpts for inspection only; candidate bytes never changed; no drawing or synthetic replacement.

individualFindings.scope: Actual opposing backbone curves and occlusions
individualFindings.observation: A: upper crest~610→lower~850→upper~1090→lower~1330→upper~1570; B opposite. At~730/970/1210/1450, each individual strand alternates front/back. Hidden ends resume along the same smooth rising or falling continuation; no same-curve merge, tangent reversal or foreground/backbone-colour identity change. Both are identically lavender, so geometry rather than colour is tracked. First~490 transition is schematic chromatin opening into two backbones; no extra branch in the genetic segment.

The repeated foreground crossing diagonal descends right. Same crossing orientation throughout is compatible with the standard right-handed projection. Paired rods bridge opposing backbones; small occluded portions terminate behind the foreground tube. No atomistic helix pitch, base-count or bond-angle claim is made.

individualFindings.scope: Gene length and shortened symbolic scale
individualFindings.observation: Brace~x720–1295 covers~575px; same-strand phase repeat is~480px. About1.2 complete rotations, not2; visible half-turn fields must not be called full turns. Long multi-base section plus clearly readable stark verkürzt makes gene-as-section intelligible; no numerical real gene-length claim. Two complete turns was the author prompt, not a binding owner requirement.

Generator substituted an X for the requested rod. It is a plausible replicated chromosome with two sister chromatids, not two different chromosomes. The square dashed local zoom selects a small region near one side of the constricted chromosome and leads to a representative chromatin/DNA strand, so it can sample one chromatid. The image does not claim the whole replicated structure comprises a single DNA molecule; generic current goal only demands organized carrier/material/section relationships. Phase and replication-state details are outside this goal.

Chromosom, Gen, DNA and stark verkürzt remain readable. The gold brace stays outside the material geometry, pale halo behind the helix; same friendly abstract comic visual style, wide PNG, ample contrast, no photographic or sterile technical reconstruction.

reviewedPrimarySources.supports: Genes are DNA sections; typical human gene length spans hundreds to millions of base pairs. Thus visible model bars and turns cannot be real-scale gene length.
Chromosomes package DNA with proteins; condensation is a division-related representation.
Replicated chromosomes have two sister chromatids connected at the centromere; local sampling one is compatible with a representative DNA zoom.
